<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option('woocommerce_currency','EUR');
update_option('woocommerce_default_country','GR');
update_option('woocommerce_calc_taxes','no');
$p=new WC_Product_Variable();$p->set_name('Test Poster');$p->set_status('publish');
$a=new WC_Product_Attribute();$a->set_name('Size');$a->set_options(['A3','A4']);$a->set_variation(true);$a->set_visible(true);$p->set_attributes([$a]);$p->save();
$ids=[];
foreach(['A3'=>'19.60','A4'=>'16.90'] as $size=>$price){$v=new WC_Product_Variation();$v->set_parent_id($p->get_id());$v->set_attributes(['size'=>$size]);$v->set_regular_price($price);$v->set_status('publish');$v->set_virtual(true);$v->save();$ids[strtolower($size)]=$v->get_id();}
WC_Product_Variable::sync($p->get_id());
update_option('posteroom_maps',array_merge($ids,['enabled'=>1,'storage'=>'/private-artwork']));
wp_insert_post(['post_title'=>'Map Designer','post_name'=>'designer','post_status'=>'publish','post_type'=>'page','post_content'=>'[posteroom_map_designer]']);
foreach(['cart'=>'[woocommerce_cart]','checkout'=>'[woocommerce_checkout]'] as $name=>$content){$id=wp_insert_post(['post_title'=>ucfirst($name),'post_name'=>$name,'post_status'=>'publish','post_type'=>'page','post_content'=>$content]);update_option('woocommerce_'.$name.'_page_id',$id);}
echo json_encode(['variations'=>$ids,'woocommerce'=>WC_VERSION,'wordpress'=>get_bloginfo('version')]);
